newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends firmer on foreign fund inflows.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends firmer on foreign fund inflows.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished firmer on Thursday, buoyed mainly by late-day inflows of foreign equity funds and U.S. dollar sales by exporters, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.489 to the U.S. dollar, against Wednesday's T$27.494 close. Turnover was US$154.5 million.

The U.S. currency's easing overseas helped strengthen the local unit, but persistent slugglish sentiment averted sharp fluctuations, dealers said. "Trading interest is very thin and I don't expect things to change anytime soon," one dealer said.
A narrow T$27.485-495 trading range was seen for Friday.
